reuse.why: Changes the rule inside the existing exported getScheduledAmount (already used across desktop-client) and routes the five inline midpoint copies in server and shared code through it.

duplication.why: Removes every duplicated midpoint expression instead of editing each copy; no new duplication is introduced.

placement.why: The rule lives in shared/schedules.ts, the module that already owns schedule amount helpers and is imported by both server and client.

scope.why: Only the rule, its call sites, tests and a release note; widening the parameter type to accept null/undefined matches the helper's existing null guard.

maintainability.why: A future change to how ranged amounts are planned is a one-line edit in one tested function.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All ranged-amount sites (schedule-template, forecast-schedules, schedules/app updateActions and postTransactionForSchedule, computeSchedulePreviewTransactions) now call getScheduledAmount.

disguised_duplication.where: No logic is duplicated; the copies are removed.

one_place.where: shared/schedules.ts getScheduledAmount; every server, shared and client path that resolves a ranged amount calls it (schedule-template keeps only its op-based isbetween dispatch around the call).
